## PR 284

**Customer model, merge rules, and the single view by phone number**

**বাংলায়:** কাস্টমার ফোন নম্বর দিয়ে একজন মানুষ: তাঁর সব প্রোফাইল আর নম্বর এক জায়গায়, বিক্রি শুধু ডেলিভারি হওয়া; একই মানুষের দুইটা প্রোফাইল একজন মানুষ দেখে একসাথে করেন, কিছু মোছে না, আবার আলাদা করা যায়; পুরো নম্বর শুধু অনুমতিতে, প্রতিটা দেখা লগে থাকে

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-10-29
  - Build status row: the customer model, the merge rules and the single view by phone (new package `@extas/customers`; migration `0047_customer_merge` additive: `Customer.mergedIntoId` / `mergedAt` with an index, `CustomerMerge` with `MERGED` / `NOT_SAME`, the rules that matched, the note, who, the Idempotency-Key and the undo; registry v60 `registry-customers.ts`): a merge only points the joining profile at the one that stays (one level, nothing moves, nothing is deleted), refused when either is erased, archived, already merged or has merged profiles of its own; "not the same person" keeps a pair from being suggested again; a split (or a "not the same" taken back) needs a note and is audited. Suggestions from `customers.merge` {suggest on, signals e-mail · WhatsApp number is the other's phone · name + address · the same identity on an order (all on), 20 a page, note required off}. The single view by phone: every profile and every number of the person, order counts and lifetime value from `@extas/metrics` (`customerKpis`: Sales = delivered only beside Ordered value, CN-022; refusals without the shop's own mistakes), any written form of a number finds him (`customerByPhone`). Phone masked without `customers.phone` (`customers.phoneMask` {first 3, last 3}); every open and every copy or call written to "Who looked at this customer" first (Note 24.1). Permissions `customers.read`, `customers.phone`, `customers.merge`. Customers → To review (`/admin/customers/review`, demo V12.4 CUS-05): the "Same person?" pairs side by side, Merge / Not the same person, the decisions with Split; API under `/api/admin/customers`
  - GitHub pull request #51, 30 Oct
- **What it does (original scope):** Customer model, merge rules, and the single view by phone number
- **Filed under:** [S14 · CRM & customers — PR 284–303](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s14--crm--customers--pr-284303)

  - Code and files: `@extas/customers`, `registry-customers.ts`, `@extas/metrics`
  - Routes: `/admin/customers/review`, `/api/admin/customers`
  - Settings and named keys: `customers.merge`, `customers.phone`, `customers.phoneMask`, `customers.read`
  - Names in the code: `0047_customer_merge`, `Customer.mergedIntoId`, `mergedAt`, `CustomerMerge`, `MERGED`, `NOT_SAME`, `customerKpis`, `customerByPhone`
- **Owning agent:** Doot
